headline: GLP-1 growth engine, priced for it
chart_note: 52-week range: $712.05 - $1,292.65. Currently around $1,120, up sharply over the past year on GLP-1 drug demand.
why_today: Eli Lilly remains one of the fastest-growing large pharma names, driven by continued strong demand for its GLP-1 weight-loss and diabetes drugs. Despite a 38x PE, the PEG ratio of 1.20 suggests the growth still isn't fully priced in relative to its own history.
pro_1: 24 of 26 analysts rate it Buy, with an average price target near $1,316 implying meaningful upside
pro_2: PEG of 1.20 is 40% below its own 10-year median - unusually reasonable for this growth rate
con_1: Trailing PE of 38x leaves little room for a GLP-1 demand slowdown or new competition
con_2: Stock is up dramatically over the past year - a lot of good news may already be reflected in the price
